introduce:
Lie on your back with your knees bent and your arms stretched forward. 

Then lift your upper body off the floor. Hold for a few seconds and slowly return. 

It primarily works the rectus abdominis muscle and the obliques.
name: ABDOMINAL CRUNCHES

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
Use your abdominal strength.
You will get better results if you do it slowly.
Relax your neck.
Always keep your lower back on the floor.
It's not right to use your arms to propel your body upwards.
To fully engage your abs, please don't use explosive strength.
Exhale when raising, and inhale when lowering.
If you feel it's too easy, hold a dumbbell in your hands.
You should feel your abdominal muscles burning.
You shouldn't feel your neck is sore.
It's a good workout for your abs.

introduce: Sit on the floor with your knees bent, feet lifted a little bit and back tilted backwards.\n\nThen hold your hands together and twist from side to side.
name: RUSSIAN TWIST

tips.text: We suggest that you do this on a mat.
Keep your neck relaxed.
Keep your legs still.
Tighten your abs.
Don't move your legs when twisting.
Breathe naturally.
To get more of a challenge, hold a dumbbell in your hands.
If you feel it's too hard, put your feet on the floor.
You should feel your abdominals burning, maybe even shivering.
This primarily targets your obliques.

introduce: Lie on your right side with your forearm supporting your body. Hold your body in a straight line. \n\nThis exercise targets the abdominal muscles and obliques.
name: SIDE PLANK RIGHT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Keep your arm at a 90 degree angle.
Keep your elbow directly under your shoulder.
Open your chest.
Always keep your body straight.
Put pressure on your wrist and elbow.
Don't put pressure on your shoulders.
Breathe regularly.
To make it easier, put your top foot forward on the mat.
Your abdominals will be burning, maybe even shivering.
Your shoulder should not be sore.
This exercise can strengthen your core.

introduce: Lie on your left side with your forearm supporting your body. Hold your body in a straight line. \n\nThis exercise targets the abdominal muscles and obliques.
name: SIDE PLANK LEFT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Keep your arm at a 90 degree angle.
Keep your elbow directly under your shoulder.
Open your chest.
Always keep your body straight.
Put pressure on your wrist and elbow.
Don't put pressure on your shoulders.
Breathe regularly.
To make it easier, put your top foot forward on the mat.
Your abdominals will be burning, maybe even shivering.
Your shoulder should not be sore.
This exercise can strengthen your core.

introduce: Lie on the ground with your legs bent and your arms by your sides. \n\nSlightly lift your upper body off the floor and make your hands alternately reach your heels.
name: HEEL TOUCH

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Keep your neck in a natural position.
Keep your lower back on the floor.
Engage your core.
Exhale when touching your heels and inhale when going back.
It's a great exercise for all of your abdominal muscles.

introduce: Lie on your back with your knees bent, feet flat on the ground and hands underneath your hips. \n\nRaise your legs to the tabletop position; drop your left foot towards the ground. Tap the ground with your toes; then raise the leg back. Switch sides, and repeat the exercise.
name: TOE TAP

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
Keep your knee steady as you drop your leg towards the ground.
Exhale as you drop your leg; inhale as you bring it back.

introduce: Sit down with your hands behind you on the ground, your legs extended and your upper body leaning backward. \n\nBend your knees, and bring them toward your chest; then fully extend your legs without touching the ground. Repeat the exercise.
name: LEG IN & OUTS

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
Please keep your core tight.
Please keep your back straight.
Please do it slowly to feel the squeezing.
Exhale when bringing your knees to your chest, and inhale when extending your legs.
Please don\'t touch the ground when you extend your leg.

introduce:
Lie flat on your back, and bend your knees into the chest. Place your hands behind your head to support your head with your fingertips.

Lift your head, neck, and shoulders off the mat, engaging your abdominal muscles.

Extend your right leg out straight into the air while simultaneously rotating your upper body to bring your right elbow towards your left bent knee. 

Switch your legs as you bring your left elbow toward your right knee. 

Repeat the exercise.
name: PILATES CRISS CROSS

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please do not strain your neck and head.
Please keep your core tight.
Please do not hold your breath.
Please keep the elbows wide.
Please make sure your pelvis is stable.
This exercise helps you build strong obliques and a more defined waistline.
